title: Old Midwife (Ida M'Toy), Jackson Mississippi
medium: Silver gelatin print mounted to museum board

events.q: Eudora’s limited editionTwenty Photographs, 1980 Portfolio was published by Palaemon Press Limited in 1980

events.n: bought the portfolio at their daughter's urging; she and her husband were then living in Winston Salem, North Carolina
events.q: They knew the printer personally and she convinced her parents to buy the portfolio given their roots in MS and friendship with Eudora.

events.who: a woman who lives in North Carolina but grew up in Mississippi
events.n: gift from her parents; the present source
events.q: Her parents later gave it to her.

events.n: all twenty prints of the portfolio
events.q: All twenty prints were exhibited at LaGrange college.
